Behavior
- R1: The existing `authorization-header` rule will consume the entire header field after `Authorization:`/`=`, bounded only by CR/LF, for every auth scheme. Digest and custom schemes with quoted, spaced, and comma-separated parameters must leave no suffix. Existing Basic, Bearer, Token, whole-header quoted forms, and `token-assignment` behavior remain green.
- R2: Reverify commit `a8a2b5bedc215d692ad1ac41d7ad9b5622e11a94` unchanged: test-time prepack remains isolated from shared `dist`, real package lifecycle coverage remains intact, and default test concurrency remains enabled. Add no production or parallel packing mechanism.

Owner
- R1 belongs solely to the existing `authorization-header` entry in `src/recorder/scanner.ts`; regenerate its tracked `dist/recorder/scanner.js` counterpart through the repository build.
- Focused scanner and existing external-input promotion coverage remain in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`; no new scanner/admission seam.
- R2 remains owned by the existing isolated materialization seam in `test/helpers/pi-test-harness.ts` and its package-lifecycle/stress suites. Verification only; no source/test edits unless the approved behavior unexpectedly fails, in which case stop and report evidence rather than invent another mechanism.

Red
- Add parameterized scanner cases that currently fail, including Digest quoted/comma-separated parameters and a custom scheme with quoted/spaced/comma-separated parameters. Assert `authorization-header` is the hit, the complete credential field and meaningful suffixes are absent, and CR/LF terminates the match so following headers/text are preserved.
- Extend one existing external-input promotion regression with one representative parameterized Authorization value and assert no complete value or parameter suffix appears in any promoted input, manifest, report, or Receipt-bearing artifact.
- Retain focused Basic/Bearer/Token and quoted-assignment cases as regression controls.

Green
- Replace only the value portion of the existing `authorization-header` regex with a CR/LF-bounded complete-field match while preserving its existing header introducer and quoted whole-value handling. Do not add a rule, post-pass, or admission sanitizer.
- Run `npm run build:recorder`; focused Authorization/external-input scanner tests; focused isolated-pack stress plus Collector/Recorder/Reviewer package-lifecycle tests; `npm run typecheck`; full `npm test` at default concurrency; and `npm pack --dry-run --json` (or the repository’s equivalent isolated pack gate).
- Diff-check with `git diff --check`, verify the pack/build gate leaves no uncommitted generated drift, and inspect the final diff against the starting HEAD.
- The Apply Receipt will include exactly these two disposition lines and no other R-like key: `R1 implemented(<test>)|refused(<reason>)` and `R2 implemented(<test>)|refused(<reason>)`, populated with concrete test evidence.

Scope
- Expected Apply changes: `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, focused cases in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, and regenerated `dist/recorder/scanner.js` only.
- Preserve all prior docket packets, dispositions, manifests, Receipts, and digests unchanged; do not inspect sessions. No Soul/schema/runtime/CLI/AC changes, no assertion weakening, no suite serialization, and no second scanner, admission, or prepack mechanism.
- Start from current HEAD `3984867`; after all gates, create exactly one new forward commit (proposed title `fix(recorder): consume complete authorization fields`), no amend/history rewrite. Confirm clean status and that new HEAD is a strict forward descendant before submitting the exact Receipt.
